_doc: Curated NARRATIVE cohorts for the class-dislocation detector (desk/class_dislocation.py). Sector cohorts are automatic; add a row here whenever a narrative names a class (versioned data, not code). Members = US-listed lines the narrative actually prices. INCLUSION CRITERION (added 2026-08-06 after the DDOG challenge): a member needs BOTH (a) the narrative mechanically applies (revenue predominantly per-seat/headcount-licensed), AND (b) the tape agrees — drawdown within ~10pp of the cohort median at review. Names failing (b) are recorded under excluded_by_tape so the boundary is falsifiable, never vibes.

agentic_saas_exposed.narrative: AI agents replace the seats that per-seat SaaS bills (the saaspocalypse)

excluded_by_tape.note: consumption/infra side of the line — the market is NOT pricing these with the narrative; re-audit if any converges to cohort median

ZS.note: per-user pricing but depth may be idiosyncratic — cause-check before cohort attribution (R2.2)

membership_audit_20260806.prior_inconsistency: TWLO (usage-based) was seeded while DDOG excluded — the criterion now governs, not the seeder's prior; TWLO stays pending its triage result

financial_data_vendors.narrative: AI disintermediates the paid financial-data/ratings/index franchise: terminals, feeds and analytics re-rated as terminal-value shorts on the assumption models replace the seat and the workflow
financial_data_vendors.mechanism: revenue predominantly SUBSCRIPTION/ISSUANCE-linked sale of proprietary financial data, ratings or indices to professional users — the layer an LLM is claimed to disintermediate. Exchanges are DELIBERATELY excluded: their revenue is transaction/clearing volume, which an AI narrative does not touch (and empirically they rallied while the vendors sold off).
financial_data_vendors.seeded_by: cohort_dislocation build 2026-08-13 — the SPGI miss: each member sat INSIDE the single-name sweep's -15pp/21d bar while the cohort median cleared -6pp with 60% breadth. Aggregate was the signal.

membership_audit_20260813.criterion: mechanism AND tape agreement; recorded series frozen at tests/golden/cohort_dislocation_datavendors_20260812.json

boundary_review.FDS: +2.5pp and MORN +10.7pp on the anchor date — mechanically IN (both sell exactly the disintermediated product) but the tape did NOT price them with the narrative. They are kept as members ON PURPOSE: dropping the members that rose would manufacture the de-rate the detector is meant to measure. Their divergence is what the ex-worst skew guard reports.
boundary_review.TRU: consumer-credit bureau — data vendor, but the pricing driver is US consumer lending volume, not the AI narrative; review, do not include
boundary_review.VRSK: yfinance files it under Consulting Services; insurance-analytics exposure is adjacent — review, do not include

excluded_by_mechanism.note: EXCHANGES. yfinance's industry label 'Financial Data & Stock Exchanges' lumps these in with the vendors, and including them flips the cohort median POSITIVE and hides the de-rate entirely — the measured dilution that forced this curated cohort to exist (see the auto-bucket regression test).

ai_displaced_services.narrative: AI does the billable work: IT services / BPO / contact centers / staffing re-rated as terminal-value shorts

private_credit_managers.narrative: Private-credit bubble fear: alt managers re-rated on default-cycle/mark-integrity/insurance-funding concerns (Athene/ADS-gating class); the principal's counter-thesis (2026-08-14) is that the fear is overdone — the cohort read tells us WHERE the fear is actually priced
private_credit_managers.mechanism: fee-related earnings on locked-up credit AUM + insurance/annuity float invested in affiliated-originated private credit; marks are Level-3 and lag public spreads in both directions
private_credit_managers.source: principal APO re-court 2026-08-14; prior owl-apo-contrarian workflow 2026-06-28

private_credit_vehicles.narrative: The VEHICLE layer of the same fear: BDCs/credit funds where private-credit stress prices as NAV discounts and dividend-cut expectations — discounts can persist long after the manager complex re-rates (APO 6% off highs while this layer may still carry the fear)
private_credit_vehicles.mechanism: listed vehicles holding private credit at Level-3 marks; price/NAV is the observable fear gauge; the BDC re-mark frontrun finding (price LEADS the mark) applies
private_credit_vehicles.source: principal APO re-court 2026-08-14; frontrun_engine BDC arm

condo_finance_exposed.narrative: LL-2026-03 phase-in (Limited Review eliminated Aug-26, 15% reserve floor, insurance relief): condo warrantability squeeze — losers = condo-volume-levered brokers/title, older-building lenders; beneficiary = compliance/management (FSV). Watch for the de-rate the tape has NOT yet shown.
condo_finance_exposed.mechanism: GSE project-eligibility gate on condo transactions: full-review requirement shrinks financeable inventory; compliance spend flows to management/reserve-study/insurance-brokering vendors
condo_finance_exposed.source: principal condo question 2026-08-14; FirmKeys/Reserve Advisors summaries of LL-2026-03

osb_prediction_market_exposed.narrative: UNNAMED — R2.2: cause not evidence-dated at seeding; FLUT -70%/SRAD -60%/DKNG -54% off 52wk highs while retail-weighted operators sit near highs. Candidate mechanisms (prediction-market share war, regulatory/tax, league-integrity) must be DATED before any is anchored.
osb_prediction_market_exposed.mechanism: pure-play online-sportsbook/online-gaming revenue exposure; the market is pricing OSB pure-plays and retail-casino operators as different classes

tape_basis.criterion: mechanism AND tape agreement ~10pp of cohort median

boundary_review.note: data/feed vendor not book operator; 18pp above median — review, do not include

excluded_by_tape.note: retail/land-based-weighted — the market is NOT pricing these with the OSB derate; the divergence IS the finding

membership_audit_20260807.seeded_by: FLUT principal question 2026-08-07 — detector post-mortem, not screen output
